sop_136.concise-zh: 商户退款｜拒绝超期退款：申请超过允许期限，且无政策例外。

sop_035.original: Only 商户退款 (merchant refund): 复核通过后恢复账户访问 / Restore access after a completed security review. Use when: Access is blocked, but identity and security review have both cleared and no active hold remains.
sop_035.concise-en: merchant refund | Restore access: blocked access, identity and security reviews cleared, no active hold.
sop_035.concise-zh: 商户退款｜恢复访问：访问受限，但身份与安全复核均通过，且无有效冻结。

sop_196.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 索取交易或工单编号 / Collect a missing transaction or ticket reference. Use when: A status inquiry has no usable reference; do not invent one.
sop_196.concise-en: transaction dispute | Collect reference: status inquiry lacks a usable transaction/ticket reference; never invent one.
sop_196.concise-zh: 交易争议｜索取编号：查询进度却无可用交易号或工单号，不得编造。

sop_000.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 完成身份验证 / Complete identity verification. Use when: The requested account operation requires identity verification, which is incomplete.
sop_000.concise-en: transaction dispute | Verify identity: requested account operation requires identity verification that is incomplete.
sop_000.concise-zh: 交易争议｜身份验证：所请求账户操作要求身份验证，但尚未完成。

sop_099.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 澄清客户意图 / Clarify an ambiguous request. Use when: The customer has not specified the desired operation; ask before acting.
sop_099.concise-en: transaction dispute | Clarify intent: desired operation unspecified; ask before acting.
sop_099.concise-zh: 交易争议｜澄清意图：客户未说明要执行的操作，先询问。

sop_080.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 转风控复核 / Escalate to compliance review. Use when: An active compliance hold overrides approvals and the customer's request to proceed.
sop_080.concise-en: transaction dispute | Compliance review: active compliance hold overrides approval and customer requests to proceed.
sop_080.concise-zh: 交易争议｜风控复核：存在有效风控冻结，优先于审批和客户继续执行的指令。

sop_042.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 冻结可疑账户访问 / Secure suspected compromised account access. Use when: The customer reports stolen credentials and unrecognized activity; secure access first.
sop_042.concise-en: transaction dispute | Secure access first: customer reports stolen credentials and unrecognized activity.
sop_042.concise-zh: 交易争议｜先保护访问：客户报告凭证被盗且出现非本人操作。

sop_015.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 阻止重复资金操作 / Prevent a duplicate funds operation. Use when: The exact requested operation is already recorded as executed under the same idempotency key.
sop_015.concise-en: transaction dispute | Prevent duplicate funds operation: the same operation is already executed under its idempotency key.
sop_015.concise-zh: 交易争议｜阻止重复资金操作：同一幂等键对应的同一操作已执行。

sop_122.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 等待链上确认 / Wait for required chain confirmations. Use when: Observed chain confirmations are below the required count; the waiting SLA has not expired.
sop_122.concise-en: transaction dispute | Wait for chain confirmations: below required count and waiting SLA not expired.
sop_122.concise-zh: 交易争议｜等待链上确认：确认数不足，且等待时限尚未过期。

sop_057.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 处理金额不足 / Request resolution of an amount shortfall. Use when: Confirmations are sufficient but the received amount is below the required amount.
sop_057.concise-en: transaction dispute | Resolve amount shortfall: confirmations sufficient but received amount below required amount.
sop_057.concise-zh: 交易争议｜处理金额不足：确认数足够，但实收金额低于所需金额。

sop_059.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 调查超过时限的等待 / Investigate processing beyond its SLA. Use when: The operation is still pending after its processing SLA, with no duplicate or compliance hold.
sop_059.concise-en: transaction dispute | Investigate delay: still pending beyond processing SLA, without duplicate execution or compliance hold.
sop_059.concise-zh: 交易争议｜调查超时：仍在等待且超过处理时限，无重复执行或风控冻结。

sop_001.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 核对外部记录与账本差异 / Reconcile provider and internal ledger mismatch. Use when: Provider completion is confirmed but the internal ledger records a different amount.
sop_001.concise-en: transaction dispute | Reconcile ledger: provider completion confirmed but internal ledger amount differs.
sop_001.concise-zh: 交易争议｜核对账本：外部已确认完成，但内部账本金额不同。

sop_187.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 核验资金接收地址 / Verify an unverified funds destination. Use when: A funds operation specifies a destination that has not yet been verified.

sop_187.concise-zh: 交易争议｜核验收款方：资金操作指定的收款地址尚未验证。

sop_194.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 提交资金操作审批 / Request the outstanding funds approval. Use when: Financial and destination checks passed, but a required approval record is missing.

sop_194.concise-zh: 交易争议｜申请审批：资金及收款方检查通过，但缺少必需的审批记录。

sop_141.concise-zh: 交易争议｜执行资金操作：资金、身份、收款方检查通过，审批有效，无冻结且此前未执行。

sop_143.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 关闭已经解决的工单 / Close the fully resolved support ticket. Use when: Execution, reconciled ledger completion and customer acknowledgement are all confirmed.

sop_143.concise-zh: 交易争议｜关闭工单：执行完成、账本对账完成及客户确认均已核实。

sop_076.original: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 解释费用 / Explain the published fee. Use when: The customer asks only for a fee explanation and is not requesting a funds operation.
